title: Arma 3

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Bohemia Interactive build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Arma 3 as a large-scale military simulation digital filing.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Bohemia multiplayer services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Multiplayer and mod-dependent holdings face elevated server and community-service risk. Account-bound licensing and the absence of a retained offline installer remain principal concerns.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam release dated September 12, 2013. Live updates and DLC revise the licensed client in place; this accession records the account-bound digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
